author: Written by Claude (Anthropic) directly as weights. No training, no gradients.
notes: Layer 1 computes how far the ball is from the paddle: each input is weighted by its column number (ball columns +k, paddle columns -k), so the sum is (ball column - paddle column). Hidden unit 0 = relu(distance) fires when the ball is to the right, hidden unit 1 = relu(-distance) fires when it is to the left. Layer 2: 'right' copies unit 0, 'left' copies unit 1, 'stay' has a small bias of 0.5 that wins only when the distance is exactly 0.
